messages:
riley: Hey team — I'm digging into a canary that saw a p95 jump last night. Need a quick checklist: where do folks pull TTFT (p50/p95/p99), tokens/sec broken out by model+route, and the raw request logs + traces? Planning to grab ~30m of metrics and a few sample traces.

sam: start with Grafana -> Inference Overview / Model Latency dashboards. Key panels: 'TTFT by quantile (p50/p95/p99) by model', 'Tokens emitted/sec by model+route', 'Active requests'. Grafana link: https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/d/abc123/inference-overview

cheng: traces live in Jaeger (service=inference-worker). Use the service dropdown, set time range, then filter by req_id or trace_id. Jaeger: https://jaeger.internal.redwood.com/search?service=inference-worker

maria: logs are in Loki now (we moved from Kibana for realtime slicing). Explore: https://loki.internal.redwood.com/explore. Example quick query: {app=\"inference\"} |= \"req=\" | json | req_id=\"req_xyz\"

sam: PromQL cheats (tweaked for shorter windows):

- TTFT p95 (1m rate):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_client_latency_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le, model))
```

- TTFT p99 (5m):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_client_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model))
```

- tokens/sec by model+route (30s window):
```
sum by (model, route)(rate(inference_tokens_emitted_total[30s]))
```

cheng: to scope to canary traffic, use label canary=\"true\" or route=~\"/canary.*\". Grafana has a variable for canary scope as well.

ops-bot: :warning: ALERT firing 33 inference_ttft_p95_high (model=redwood/gpt-4-mini) 33 p95=985ms over last 5m. link: https://alerting.internal.redwood.com/alert/9999

devops: quick triage checklist: pull the Latency panels and these too: 'batching_utilization', 'kv_cache_misses_per_sec', 'gpu_queue_latency_ms'. Correlate tokens/sec with batching. Patterns: if tokens/sec spikes while batching_utilization drops -> likely long single-request generation (many tokens). If batching_utilization spikes + gpu_queue_latency spikes -> scheduling/backpressure.

maria: mapping req_id -> trace: logs include a trace=... field. Loki example to extract trace id:
```
{app=\"inference\"} |= \"req=\\\"req_abc123\\\"\" | json | line_format \"trace={{.trace}}\"
```
Copy trace value and paste into Jaeger search.

sam: alert tuning notes: the org-level p95 alert is currently p95 > 400ms for 5m. For model-specific tuning we recommend raising the threshold for lower-tier models (e.g., p95 > 700ms for 5m) and keeping stricter thresholds for premium models (p95 > 250ms for 5m). Also consider per-route alerts for long-token routes.

riley: I'll pull traces + a 30-minute snapshot of metrics and post a couple trace ids. Do folks want a flamegraph / profiler output from the GPU node for the window?

devops: yes please. If you can, collect: pstack or java/flame profiler (depending on process), nvidia-smi output, and `psrecord` for CPU/mem. Also capture `nvidia-smi pmon` for the interval. Tar up to /mnt/obs/cases/2765432100/

maria: one more tip for noise reduction: look at `inference_kv_cache_hit_ratio` and `startup_time_ms` panels. Cold-starts show up as low kv cache hit ratio + elevated startup_time. Batching-related throughput issues will show kv cache hit ratio steady but gpu_queue latency elevated.

riley: great — I'll coordinate node access and upload the artifacts. Runbook pointer: https://wiki.internal.redwood.com/obs/latency-triage-v2. I'll post Loki query + Jaeger links back here once I have them. :thumbsup:
